rounds.note: Baseline. Three-tool definition comparison, first localization measurement on the 65 reused issues, and the two-task Codex navigation pilot.
First context-ranking iteration; localization re-measured. Two-task Codex bugfix pilot: Findex had one 300-second timeout.
Locality ranking iteration (conceptual vs exact split, filename words, nearby evidence). Bugfix pilot repeated: all tools solve both tasks, codebase-memory uses fewer tokens than Findex.
No ranking change since R2. Re-measured on HEAD to confirm the numbers; the live harness was repaired the same day (invalid sessions no longer halt a study; single-definition tasks; answer parsing).

First Claude Code live round on HEAD with the repaired harness: four single-definition tasks, three tools, Claude Haiku via subscription. Every session spent a tool-search turn; the harness prompt steered Findex to its deferred tools.

BM25 scores serialized to three decimals (about 8% fewer Findex tokens per query, same hits). Harness hint now points Findex sessions at the upfront findex_context tool, so they skip the tool-search turn. Same four tasks as R4.
No Findex change since R5. Four fresh tasks (ripgrep, fmt, two requests) to check that the R5 result holds beyond the tasks the hint was written against; the rivals had more invalid sessions.
Concept ranking demotes vendored copies (factor 0.5) and docs, examples and support scripts (0.7) on the BM25 score. Five tasks moved up, none down.

Concept ranking relaxes FTS5's fixed BM25 length normalisation (b 0.75 to 0.3, set in advance, not fitted) so large central files are no longer penalised. Dev and test both improve; 19 tasks moved up, 5 down (none beyond rank 13).
